You'd never expect a golden orb on the seafloor.
But in 2023, NOAA found one, two miles deep. What was it, actually?
Scientists guessed a sponge, a coral, even an egg case. On the ship, they could only say it was biological.
In 2026, lab tests and DNA gave the answer: part of the base of a giant deep-sea anemone.
Five more deep sea mysteries are on the channel.
